insight: Built by the Windsurf team Google brought in via a $2.4B July 2025 licensing deal, after OpenAI's Windsurf buyout collapsed.
name: Google Antigravity
tagline: Agentic development platform built on a VS Code fork.
description: Google's agent-first IDE where autonomous agents plan, execute, and verify coding tasks across the editor, terminal, and browser. A Manager view orchestrates multiple agents in parallel, and agents produce Artifacts — task lists, plans, screenshots, browser recordings — so you can check their work at a glance. Launched in public preview alongside Gemini 3.

modelSupport.notes: Defaults to Gemini 3; Anthropic and open models are selectable.

edge: Agent-first VS Code fork where agents emit verifiable Artifacts — plans, screenshots, recordings — not just diffs.
pros: Launched with Gemini 3, free in preview
cons: Ties best into Google's Gemini models
